data.name: Swiftgram
data.subtitle: Supercharged open-source Telegram fork
data.localizedDescription: Swiftgram is a supercharged, open-source Telegram fork: ghost mode, hide read receipts and online status, save protected media, unlimited account switching and deep interface customization. The project officially ships through the App Store and TestFlight; this entry serves a ready-to-sideload IPA build (Swiftgram base with the MxGram tweak).

compatibility.notes: Swiftgram's official distribution channels are the App Store and TestFlight and the project publishes no sideload IPA, so this source serves a community-built IPA from the IPA Vault, clearly labelled in the feed. Telegram 12.x requires iOS 13 or newer. The IPA Vault lists the MxGram variant as app.swiftgram.ios.mxgram; a signing client may change the identifier.
